verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents agents that process video input from rooms, so an agent can consume live media as a participant. The evidence does not explicitly show that an agent can subscribe to only one chosen track, or that the publisher's setup stays unchanged. The closest single-track evidence is Track Egress (PASSTHROUGH export of one video track), but that is a different feature: export to a file or stream, not agent subscription. Missing for 10: documented selective per-track subscription for agents, explicit statement that publishers need no changes, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes

citations.quote: Create AI assistants that process video input.
